summary: Waterdrop Inc. (NYSE: WDH) filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of independent director Heping Feng for personal reasons, effective July 1, 2026, and the appointment of Qianfei Chang as his replacement. No specific terms, price, premium, or advisors cited. The board approved the appointment; Ms. Chang will also chair the audit committee. This is a planned board succession with no disclosed dispute. As a routine independent director change with no strategic event, the risk-arb angle is minimal; watch for any subsequent governance shifts or regulatory filings.
